001package org.clafer.choco.constraint;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.Model;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Constraint;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.binary.PropEqualXY_C;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.binary.PropEqualX_Y;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.binary.PropEqualX_YC;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.binary.PropGreaterOrEqualX_Y;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.binary.PropNotEqualX_Y;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.set.PropSubsetEq;
013import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.unary.PropEqualXC;
014import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.unary.PropGreaterOrEqualXC;
015import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.unary.PropLessOrEqualXC;
016import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.unary.PropNotEqualXC;
017import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
018import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
019import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropContinuous;
020import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropElement;
021import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropElementArraySupport;
022import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropElementValueSupport;
023import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropEqualXY_Z;
024import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropIntMemberNonemptySet;
025import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropLength;
026import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropSetLowBound;
027import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropSetStrictHighBound;
028import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropUtil;
029
030/**
031 *
032 * @author jimmy
033 */
034public class Propagators {
035
036    final Propagator<?>[] propagators;
037    int size = 0;
038
039    public Propagators(int capacity) {
040        this.propagators = new Propagator<?>[capacity];
041    }
042
043    public Propagators post(Propagator<?> propagator) {
044        propagators[size++] = propagator;
045        return this;
046    }
047
048    public Propagators eq(IntVar l, IntVar r) {
049        if (l.isInstantiated()) {
050            return eq(r, l.getValue());
051        } else if (r.isInstantiated()) {
052            return eq(l, r.getValue());
053        }
054        return post(new PropEqualX_Y(l, r));
055    }
056
057    public Propagators eq(IntVar l, int r) {
058        if (l.isInstantiatedTo(r)) {
059            return this;
060        }
061        return post(new PropEqualXC(l, r));
062    }
063
064    public Propagators neq(IntVar l, IntVar r) {
065        if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(l, r)) {
066            return this;
067        } else if (l.isInstantiated()) {
068            return neq(r, l.getValue());
069        } else if (r.isInstantiated()) {
070            return neq(l, r.getValue());
071        }
072        return post(new PropNotEqualX_Y(l, r));
073    }
074
075    public Propagators neq(IntVar l, int r) {
076        if (l.contains(r)) {
077            return post(new PropNotEqualXC(l, r));
078        }
079        return this;
080    }
081
082    public Propagators leq(IntVar l, IntVar g) {
083        if (l.getUB() <= g.getLB()) {
084            return this;
085        } else if (l.isInstantiated()) {
086            return post(new PropGreaterOrEqualXC(g, l.getValue()));
087        } else if (g.isInstantiated()) {
088            return post(new PropLessOrEqualXC(l, g.getValue()));
089        }
090        return post(new PropGreaterOrEqualX_Y(new IntVar[]{g, l}));
091    }
092
093    public Propagators geq(IntVar g, IntVar l) {
094        return leq(l, g);
095    }
096
097    public Propagators add(int x, IntVar y, IntVar z) {
098        if (x == 0) {
099            return eq(y, z);
100        } else if (y.isInstantiated()) {
101            return eq(z, x + y.getValue());
102        } else if (z.isInstantiated()) {
103            return eq(y, z.getValue() - x);
104        } else {
105            return post(new PropEqualX_YC(new IntVar[]{y, z}, -x));
106        }
107    }
108
109    public Propagators add(IntVar x, IntVar y, int z) {
110        if (x.isInstantiated()) {
111            return eq(y, z - x.getValue());
112        } else if (y.isInstantiated()) {
113            return eq(x, z - y.getValue());
114        } else {
115            return post(new PropEqualXY_C(new IntVar[]{x, y}, z));
116        }
117    }
118
119    public Propagators add(IntVar x, IntVar y, IntVar z) {
120        if (x.isInstantiated()) {
121            return add(x.getValue(), y, z);
122        } else if (y.isInstantiated()) {
123            return add(y.getValue(), x, z);
124        } else if (z.isInstantiated()) {
125            return add(x, y, z.getValue());
126        } else {
127            return post(new PropEqualXY_Z(x, y, z));
128        }
129    }
130
131    public Propagators element(IntVar value, IntVar[] array, IntVar index, int offset) {
132        if (value.isInstantiated()) {
133            int v = value.getValue();
134            int ub = index.getUB();
135            for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
136                int j = i + offset;
137                if (j < 0 || j >= array.length || !array[j].isInstantiatedTo(v)) {
138                    return post(new PropElement(value, array, index, offset));
139                }
140            }
141            return this;
142        }
143        return post(new PropElement(value, array, index, offset));
144    }
145
146    public Propagators elementArraySupport(IntVar value, IntVar[] array, IntVar index, int offset, int support) {
147        if (index.getUB() < array.length) {
148            int ub = index.getUB();
149            for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
150                int j = i + offset;
151                if (j >= 0 && j < array.length && (array[j].contains(support) || PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(value, array[j]))) {
152                    if (index.isInstantiated() && value.isInstantiated() && array[j].isInstantiated()) {
153                        return this;
154                    }
155                }
156            }
157        }
158        return post(new PropElementArraySupport(value, array, index, offset, support));
159    }
160
161    public Propagators elementValueSupport(IntVar value, IntVar[] array, IntVar index, int offset, int support) {
162        if (!value.contains(support)) {
163            return element(value, array, index, offset);
164        } else if (value.isInstantiated() && index.getUB() < array.length) {
165            return this;
166        }
167        return post(new PropElementValueSupport(value, array, index, offset, support));
168    }
169
170    public Propagators length(IntVar[] chars, IntVar length, int terminator) {
171        if (length.isInstantiated()) {
172            int l = length.getValue();
173            if (l < chars.length) {
174                for (int i = 0; i < l; i++) {
175                    if (chars[i].contains(terminator)) {
176                        return post(new PropLength(chars, length, terminator));
177                    }
178                }
179                for (int i = l; i < chars.length; i++) {
180                    if (!chars[i].isInstantiatedTo(terminator)) {
181                        return post(new PropLength(chars, length, terminator));
182                    }
183                }
184                return this;
185            }
186        }
187        return post(new PropLength(chars, length, terminator));
188    }
189
190    public Propagators subsetEq(SetVar subset, SetVar superSet) {
191        if (PropUtil.isEnvSubsetKer(subset, superSet)) {
192            return this;
193        }
194        return post(new PropSubsetEq(subset, superSet));
195    }
196
197    public Propagators lowBound(SetVar set, IntVar bound) {
198        if (set.getUB().isEmpty() || bound.getUB() <= set.getUB().min()) {
199            return this;
200        }
201        return post(new PropSetLowBound(set, bound));
202    }
203
204    public Propagators strictHighBound(SetVar set, IntVar bound) {
205        if (set.getUB().isEmpty() || bound.getLB() > set.getUB().max()) {
206            return this;
207        }
208        return post(new PropSetStrictHighBound(set, bound));
209    }
210
211    public Propagators memberNonempty(IntVar element, SetVar set, IntVar setCard) {
212        if (setCard.getUB() == 0 || PropUtil.isDomSubsetKer(element, set)
213                || (set.getUB().size() == 1 && element.isInstantiatedTo(set.getUB().min()))) {
214            return this;
215        }
216        return post(new PropIntMemberNonemptySet(element, set, setCard));
217    }
218
219    public Propagators continuous(SetVar set, IntVar card) {
220        if (set.isInstantiated()
221                && (set.getUB().isEmpty()
222                || set.getLB().max() - set.getLB().min() + 1 == set.getUB().size())) {
223            return this;
224        } else if (card.getUB() == 1) {
225            return this;
226        }
227        return post(new PropContinuous(set, card));
228    }
229
230    public Constraint toConstraint(String name, Model model) {
231        if (size == 0) {
232            return model.trueConstraint();
233        } else if (size == propagators.length) {
234            return new Constraint(name, propagators);
235        }
236        return new Constraint(name, Arrays.copyOf(propagators, size));
237    }
238}
